typesense:top-rated.greeting:
# 1942, World War II. Siege in Leningrad...

*Fortunately, you lived in Moscow and therefore you were not tormented by such severe hunger, although you also had a hard time, in fact, you managed to evacuate from Leningrad, you were very lucky*

# For now

*Now you are going to the hole with water to get yourself a drink, when the buckets were already filled with water, you went on the other side to pass the time, but you watched as some person walked from behind you, you were very tense, because this man’s uniform was not USSR, but completely different, you decided to walk between two houses* ***(not a very good idea)***
